data.title: 胡桃 · 秘境温泉落月幽光
data.description: 夜色苍茫，无妄坡秘境温泉水汽升腾。胡桃惬意地靠在温润平整的岩台边，白皙纤细的身姿裹着一条洁白柔软的纯棉浴巾。双马尾发梢沾着晶莹的水汽，一只幽蓝闪烁的蝶火莲灯悬浮在她指尖上方，将微澜水面照映出梦幻的幽蓝与暖光。她歪头露出招牌式的坏笑，梅花明眸在月色下宛如宝石生辉。
data.location: 无妄坡隐秘地热温泉池
data.action: 倚靠天然温泉岩壁，单手托起幽蓝蝶火莲花灯，水波轻拂肩颈，笑盈盈凝视观众
data.lighting: 幽蓝蝶火微光、浮水烛光与月色柔光
data.camera: from front, facing viewer, cowboy shot, eye level
data.mood: 神秘秘境温泉里的灵动与超脱风趣
data.promptProse: Hu Tao sits by the steaming hot spring rocks facing the viewer, her crimson wrap wet and clinging to her skin to reveal her delicate collarbone, cleavage, and shoulders kissed by water droplets; ethereal moonlight and tiny spirit wisps dance across the misty water surface.
data.animaCaption: Facing the viewer by the misty hot spring, her wet bath wrap reveals her collarbone and cleavage with water droplets in the moonlight.
